description: This file declares an interface IController for controlling or managing components in the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes virtual functions for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment querying, configuration management, and cloning, primarily serving as an interface that should be implemented elsewhere.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface defining control operations such as Persist, Delete, Reboot, Environment, Configuration, and Clone within the PluginHost namespace of WPEFramework. It inherits virtually from Core::IUnknown and is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the component or resource at the specified path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment information based on the provided index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for the specified callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the specified callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a base callsign with a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
